correctness.rationale: The divisor pairs of 2^a p are exactly (2^i,p2^{a-i}); subtracting an omitted union from the exact divisor sum gives a reversible equation M-A_I=p(1+B_I). The finite cutoff enumerates every possible mask for a<=11, which is exhaustive because a>=12 already forces n>11776. Direct divisor-sum checks confirm each surviving case.
